features.statement: Document title uses an en-dash and repeats the hero headline instead of a 'Brand | tagline' pattern.
Page content is wrapped in a <main> landmark element.
Heading outline is clean: h1, then h2 for each section title, with items as h3.
Uses semantic inline elements such as <q> for quotes, plus many <small> and <strong> for metadata, and an ordered list.
Typography uses a Helvetica Neue/Arial system font stack rather than a web font.
Hero H1 is split into a large bold first line and a smaller gray secondary line.
Section headings are bold, large (32px) and left-aligned.
Body text is dark charcoal rather than pure black.
Palette is warm: peach accents with dark rust text, no cool teal.
Alternating sections are banded with pale peach/cream tinted backgrounds.
Hero fades the photo to a light wash, with dark text and the search bar left-aligned.
Hero search field has an inline filled pill 'Search' button instead of an icon.
Navigation is plain text without dropdown carets; the primary call-to-action is a filled accent pill and the secondary is a text link.
Logo is inset to align with a centred content container.
Category tiles are flat, tinted, rounded, text-only cards in a regular grid of equal rows.
Layout relies on CSS grid for regular multi-column arrangements.
Process steps are bordered cards with numbered accent-colored circles.
Ranked list cards use large accent rank numbers and bold titles, with no images or stars.
Review and product cards are compact text-only cards, with no large image areas.
Award cards are text cards with an accent left border, plus a 'Show all' button that truncates the list.
Category labels are set in uppercase, using an accent text color.
Article list is a ruled list of divider rows with bold dark titles and a trailing accent arrow.
Intro/about block uses a two-column split with the heading left and gray body text right.
Promo is a rounded dark navy panel with a large white heading, an accent pill CTA and a rounded photo.
Images are displayed at full size with descriptive alt text.
Social links are plain underlined text labels, with no icons.
Corners are moderately rounded (8–15px), with several pill shapes.
Footer is dark, with the logo on a white rounded chip and the copyright line below.
Page is compact and short, with few sections and little repeated content.
Markup is lean: few divs, one script, an inline style block and a small set of hand-written classes.
Cards are separated with 1px borders and almost no shadows, gradients or transforms.
Decoration is CSS-based, with no inline SVG icons and few images.
Content is aligned to a consistent left edge in a centred max-width container across all sections.
Review counts appear as small accent-tinted pill badges.
Uses few ARIA attributes, relying on native semantics.
